name.description: Resource name (e.g. product, sp-year). Route: admin/<dasherized-name>

app.description: Monorepo app the resource belongs to (apps/<app>). Default: api (or the app of --sourceRoot)

path.description: Folder the resource folder is created in. Default: apps/<app>/src/modules

fields.description: Field spec name:type[:modifier...][?], comma-separated. Types: string, string(N), text, int, number, decimal(p,s), boolean, date, json, enum(a|b), relation(Entity), relation(Entity[]), file(image|video|audio|pdf|other), file(kind)[]. Modifiers: unique, index, default(v), min(n), max(n), cascade, set-null, label(field). Trailing ? = nullable. Default: name:string

module.description: Module file the new module is registered in. Default: apps/<app>/src/<app>.module.ts

dbLib.description: Database library source folder (entity goes to <dbLib>/entities)

skipImport.description: Do not register the module in the root module

migration.description: Generate a CREATE TABLE migration in libs/database/src/migrations (--no-migration to skip)

seed.description: Generate libs/database/src/seeds/<name>.seed.ts with N demo rows (development only)

sourceRoot.description: Passed by the Nest CLI (apps/<app>/src); used to pick --app

language.description: Ignored (Nest CLI passes it); only ts is generated

flat.description: Ignored (Nest CLI passes it); resources always get their own folder

force.description: Overwrite generated files that you have edited (default: keep them and warn)
